title: Pet Crowdfunding
tagline: Our initative is a site for crowdfunding to help abandoned pets, using Vercel, Next.js, IPFS and Solidity.
description: Our initiative is looking to help some animal shelters to raise funding for they daily operations, in a frontend based in Vercel, Next.js, with a connection to an ETH wallet into the Ropstein testnet and a call for a smart contract and saving data into IPFS, all of that to manage a website to support people and shelters to help some abandoned pets.
how_its_made: Our project is using IPFS to store the pictures, this is very interesting because we take advantage from the network's immutability to assure that our information is valid, also we deploy a smart contract into a testnet to automate some needs into the organization like the proposals and requests for funding.
